from solution import rear_extract


def test_issue_example_matches_description():
    """Example: rear_extract([(1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20), (3, 'Kil', 19)]) == [21, 20, 19]."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20), (3, 'Kil', 19)])
    assert result == [21, 20, 19]  # rears by inspection: 21, 20, 19


def test_issue_empty_input_returns_empty():
    """Rear extraction from empty list of records is empty."""
    result = rear_extract([])
    assert result == []  # no tuples so no rears: []


def test_issue_single_record():
    """Rear extraction from a single tuple record gives its last element."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 'Rash', 21)])
    assert result == [21]  # rear of (1, 'Rash', 21) is 21


def test_issue_two_element_tuples():
    """Rear extraction returns the last element of 2-tuples."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 10), (2, 20), (3, 30)])
    assert result == [10, 20, 30]  # rears by inspection: 10, 20, 30


def test_issue_four_element_tuples():
    """Rear extraction returns the last element of 4-tuples."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 2, 3, 4), (5, 6, 7, 8)])
    assert result == [4, 8]  # rears by inspection: 4, 8


def test_issue_mixed_lengths_use_last_element():
    """Rear means last element even when tuple lengths differ."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 2), (3, 4, 5), (6, 7, 8, 9)])
    assert result == [2, 5, 9]  # rears by inspection: 2, 5, 9


def test_issue_singleton_tuples():
    """Rear extraction from 1-tuples returns the only element."""
    result = rear_extract([(7,), (8,), (9,)])
    assert result == [7, 8, 9]  # rears by inspection: 7, 8, 9


def test_issue_mixed_value_types():
    """Rear extraction works for non-integer rear values."""
    result = rear_extract([(1, 'a'), (2, 'b'), (3, None)])
    assert result == ['a', 'b', None]  # rears by inspection: 'a', 'b', None


def test_contract_returns_list_of_rears_in_order():
    """Extracted rears must be returned as a list in input order."""
    result = rear_extract([(3, 'Kil', 19), (1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20)])
    assert result == [19, 21, 20]  # rears in order: 19, 21, 20


def test_contract_does_not_modify_input_list():
    """Rear extraction must not modify the input list of records."""
    data = [(1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20)]
    rear_extract(data)
    assert data == [(1, 'Rash', 21), (2, 'Varsha', 20)]  # input unchanged: same 2 tuples
